seo.title: seoMatchesTitle
seo.minimum_data: The warehouse flags an opening day in mart_match_days (the build day, else the next day with a match); a day exists only when a competition's last or next matchday has a match on it. Every unplayed row links to its match page, which the build emits from fixtures/{fixture_id}.json; a played row is not a link until the match report page exists.
seo.url_permanence_note: The address is the matches word of site_architecture.md "Address words" and never moves; the day it shows is the opening day of each nightly build, which is why no dated address repeats it.
